release.releaseNotes:
Private update for Bob (Build 126 - Full Admin Page UI Adjustment Controller).
• Full UI Controller: Tap [ 🎛️ Adjust UI ] in the top header to reveal interactive real-time tuning panel.
• Gauge Tuning: Live adjust Speedometer size, needle length/width, glow, ambient dial backlight, and redline threshold.
• Central Readout & Messages: Nudge vertical readout Y-offset, font sizes, status pill position, live sync and alert banners.
• Every Card Adjustable: Toggle visibility, card corner radius, padding, waveform height, tech specs, topic matrix, retention timeouts, and action dock height.
• Instant Feedback & Persistence: Changes reflect instantly on screen and persist automatically with single-tap Reset Defaults.
